title: Unable to access Salesforce - SSO Handshake Timeout
description: Salesforce login keeps redirecting to Okta error page: 'SAML response validation failed (Clock skew or expired assertion)'. Need access urgently for Q4 close.
mock_ocr_text:
Error: StatusCode=401 Unauthorized
AssertionConsumerServiceURL: https://company.my.salesforce.com?so=00D5e0000018
SAMLResponse: Status Invalid, clock skew exceeds allowable threshold 180s.
resolution_steps:
1. Resync local NTP time service using `w32tm /resync /force`
2. Invalidate Okta cached active tokens via Admin API `POST /api/v1/users/{id}/lifecycle/reset_factors`
3. Clear Google Chrome SAML cookie storage for `.salesforce.com` and restart browser session
4. Verified SSO handshake completes with status 200 OK.

title: Cisco AnyConnect VPN Connection Timeout (Gateway Unreachable)
description: Remote worker unable to connect to corporate VPN. AnyConnect hangs at 'Contacting vpn.corp.internal' then drops with error: 'Connection attempt has timed out'.
mock_ocr_text:
Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client v4.10
[VPN ERROR] The VPN client was unable to successfully verify the IP forwarding table.
Failed to obtain IP address from DHCP pool.
Connection attempt has timed out.
resolution_steps:
1. Restart Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Agent service (`net stop csc_vpnagent && net start csc_vpnagent`)
2. Reset Windows Socket stack and flush DNS cache (`netsh winsock reset && ipconfig /flushdns`)
3. Verify split tunneling routing table metric for interface 0.0.0.0/0
4. Connection established successfully with assigned corporate IP 10.45.12.88.

title: VPN Split-Tunneling DNS Leak & Internal Host Resolution Failure
description: Connected to VPN but cannot resolve internal intranet hosts like `git.corp.local` or `jira.corp.local`. External websites work normally.
mock_ocr_text:
nslookup git.corp.local
Server: UnKnown
Address: 192.168.1.1
*** UnKnown can't find git.corp.local: Non-existent domain
resolution_steps:
1. Re-prioritize network adapter binding order placing TAP-Windows Adapter on top
2. Add corporate DNS suffix list `corp.local, corp.internal` into IPv4 adapter properties
3. Flush client resolver cache (`ipconfig /flushdns`)
4. DNS lookup for `git.corp.local` correctly resolves to internal IP 10.20.4.15.

title: Outlook SSO Redirect Loop & Credential Prompt Storm
description: Outlook desktop client keeps prompting for Microsoft 365 credentials in a modal popup loop every 5 seconds without accepting password.
mock_ocr_text:
Microsoft Outlook: Need Password
Modern Authentication Token Refresh Failed
Error AADSTS50076: Due to a configuration change made by your administrator, you must use multi-factor authentication to access.
resolution_steps:
1. Close Outlook and disconnect work account from Windows Settings -> Accounts -> Access work or school
2. Clear Microsoft Identity credentials from Windows Credential Manager under `Generic Credentials`
3. Delete cached token files under `%localappdata%\Packages\Microsoft.AAD.BrokerPlugin_cw5n1h2txyewy`
4. Re-authenticate with Authenticator App push notification; Outlook sync restored.

title: Azure AD Password Expiration Sync Lockout across Devices
description: Password was updated on web portal 2 hours ago, but MacBook and mobile phone are locked out with 'Invalid credentials' on Kerberos ticket.
mock_ocr_text:
Directory Services Authentication Error 80090308: LdapErr: DSID-0C090447, comment: AcceptSecurityContext error, data 532, v3839
User account password has expired on Domain Controller DC02.
resolution_steps:
1. Force Azure AD Connect delta synchronization via PowerShell: `Start-ADSyncSyncCycle -PolicyType Delta`
2. Verify synchronization status in Azure AD Connect Synchronization Service Manager
3. Purge Kerberos tickets on affected workstation (`klist purge`)
4. Re-issue TGT ticket with updated credential.

title: Outlook Calendar Sync Stalled & OST Data File Corruption
description: Executive calendar invites are not syncing to desktop Outlook. Send/Receive error 0x8004010F reported.
mock_ocr_text:
Task 'Microsoft Exchange' reported error (0x8004010F): 'The Outlook data file cannot be accessed.'
Path: C:\Users\dkim\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Outlook\dkim@corp.com.ost
resolution_steps:
1. Terminate `outlook.exe` background processes
2. Rename damaged OST file to `dkim@corp.com.ost.old`
3. Launch Outlook with switch `outlook.exe /cleanreminders /resetnavpane`
4. Outlook automatically re-created fresh OST cache from Exchange server.

title: Office 365 Shared Mailbox Missing Permissions after Org Move
description: Employee transferred to Finance department cannot open the `billing-inquiries@corp.com` shared mailbox.
mock_ocr_text:
Cannot expand the folder. You do not have permission to log on to the mailbox.
Exchange Online MailboxGuid: 3e7c8b21-4f11-4a99
resolution_steps:
1. Execute Exchange Online PowerShell command: `Add-MailboxPermission -Identity 'billing-inquiries@corp.com' -User 'radams@corp.com' -AccessRights FullAccess -InheritanceType All -AutoMapping $true`
2. Run `Add-RecipientPermission -Identity 'billing-inquiries@corp.com' -Trustee 'radams@corp.com' -AccessRights SendAs`
3. Wait 10 minutes for M365 replication; verified mailbox mounted.

title: FollowMe Network Printer Drops Mapping after DHCP Lease Renewal
description: Floor 3 Xerox FollowMe printer shows 'Offline' status on multiple workstations after the morning network DHCP lease update.
mock_ocr_text:
Print Queue: \\printserver01\Floor3-Xerox-Color
Status: Offline - Driver host process failed.
WSD Port: WSD-55f84d63-2287-4a0b IP: 192.168.40.112 (Unreachable)
resolution_steps:
1. Change printer port from dynamic WSD to Standard TCP/IP Port bound to static DNS `xerox-fl3.printers.corp`
2. Restart Print Spooler service on printserver: `Restart-Service Spooler -Force`
3. Clear stuck documents in `C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS`
4. Sent test page; print job finished successfully.

title: Oracle DB Connection Pool Timeout (ORA-12154 TNS could not resolve service name)
description: Production billing microservice throws ORA-12154 when scaling new replicas in Kubernetes cluster.
mock_ocr_text:
oracle.net.ns.NetException: ORA-12154: TNS:could not resolve the connect identifier specified
  at oracle.jdbc.driver.T4CConnection.logon(T4CConnection.java:854)
  at com.zaxxer.hikari.pool.HikariPool.createPoolEntry(HikariPool.java:473)
resolution_steps:
1. Inspect Kubernetes ConfigMap `oracle-tnsnames` mounted at `/opt/oracle/network/admin`
2. Fix missing net service descriptor for `BILLING_PROD_RAC` in `tnsnames.ora`
3. Execute zero-downtime rolling restart: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/billing-service -n core`
4. Verified HikariCP pool initialized with 20 active connections.

title: PostgreSQL Staging Connection Pool Exhaustion (FATAL: remaining connection slots reserved)
description: Integration test runner fails with 'FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections'.
mock_ocr_text:
psycopg2.OperationalError: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
Active connections: 100/100, Idle in transaction: 74 connections from client IP 10.244.3.18
resolution_steps:
1. Identify and terminate zombie test transactions: `SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'idle in transaction' AND state_change < now() - INTERVAL '5 minutes';`
2. Configure PgBouncer transaction-mode pooling with `max_client_conn = 500`
3. Enforce `idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = '60000'` in postgresql.conf
4. Database active connections dropped to 14; staging tests resumed.

title: Kubernetes Pod CrashLoopBackOff via Memory OOMKilled (Exit Code 137)
description: Recommendation engine pod crashes every 4 minutes. `kubectl describe pod` shows Last State: Terminated with Reason: OOMKilled.
mock_ocr_text:
State: Waiting
  Reason: CrashLoopBackOff
Last State: Terminated
  Reason: OOMKilled
  Exit Code: 137
Limits:
  memory: 512Mi
Requests:
  memory: 256Mi
resolution_steps:
1. Analyze heap dump indicating memory leak in cache serialization layer
2. Patch deployment resource limits: `kubectl set resources deployment/recommender -c app --limits=memory=2Gi --requests=memory=1Gi -n prod`
3. Enable JVM container options `-XX:+UseContainerSupport -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75.0`
4. Pod status stabilized at Running with 0 restarts.

title: Docker Private Registry ImagePullBackOff (x509 Certificate Unknown Authority)
description: Worker nodes failing to pull images from internal harbor registry: `harbor.corp.internal/apps/frontend:v2.4`.
mock_ocr_text: Failed to pull image "harbor.corp.internal/apps/frontend:v2.4": rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to pull and unpack image: failed to verify certificate: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
resolution_steps:
1. Distribute corporate internal root CA certificate to all Kubernetes nodes at `/etc/docker/certs.d/harbor.corp.internal/ca.crt`
2. Run `update-ca-certificates` on host nodes and restart containerd daemon (`systemctl restart containerd`)
3. Re-trigger image pull test: `crictl pull harbor.corp.internal/apps/frontend:v2.4`
4. Image pulled successfully, all pods transition to Running.

title: OAuth 2.0 API Gateway Token Verification Clock Skew Mismatch
description: Downstream partner API calls returning HTTP 401: 'The token is not valid yet (nbf claim in future)'.
mock_ocr_text:
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="The token nbf claim 1718029340 is greater than current timestamp 1718029315 by 25 seconds."
resolution_steps:
1. Configure JWT validation library clock skew tolerance to 60 seconds (`jwtOptions.ClockSkew = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1)`)
2. Resynchronize chrony NTP daemon across API gateway cluster (`chronyc -a makestep`)
3. Verify token validation against partner public JWKS keyset
4. Subsequent API calls returned HTTP 200 with valid claims payload.

title: Redis Cluster Split-Brain & Authentication NOAUTH Failure
description: Session store microservice threw NOAUTH errors following failover of master redis node to sentinel replica.
mock_ocr_text:
redis.exceptions.ResponseError: NOAUTH Authentication required.
RedisClusterReplica: Node 10.0.12.44:6379 failed to authenticate with master_auth parameter.
resolution_steps:
1. Inspect `redis.conf` across sentinel nodes; discovered `masterauth` password missing on replica node 3
2. Dynamically set authentication password without restart: `CONFIG SET masterauth 'SecretClusterPass!2026'` and `CONFIG REWRITE`
3. Execute `SENTINEL failover mymaster` to verify seamless quorum handover
4. All session read/write commands verified healthy across cluster topology.

title: Internal Gateway SSL Cert Expiry (ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR)
description: All employees receiving browser security alerts 'Your connection is not private' when accessing internal customer portal.
mock_ocr_text:
NET::ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID
Subject: CN=*.internal.corp.com
Issuer: DigiCert Global Root G2
Validity: Not After: Today 00:00:00 GMT
ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR
resolution_steps:
1. Trigger automated Let's Encrypt / DigiCert renewal workflow via Cert-Manager: `kubectl renew certificate internal-corp-wildcard -n ingress`
2. Verify renewed certificate validity window extended for 365 days
3. Reload NGINX Ingress controller pods to mount updated TLS secret
4. Verified HTTPS handshake with TLS 1.3 across desktop and mobile clients.
